array.string: test -n "$C_NOTIFY_SSH_TARGET" || { echo "C_NOTIFY_SSH_TARGET is required" >&2; exit 1; }; exec ssh -N -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 -R ${C_NOTIFY_REMOTE_BIND_ADDRESS:-127.0.0.1}:${C_NOTIFY_REMOTE_PORT:-38765}:127.0.0.1:${C_NOTIFY_LOCAL_PORT:-38765} "$C_NOTIFY_SSH_TARGET"
